title: Master Mattes® Eyeshadow Palette: The Original
descriptionHtml:
✓ allure 2024 Best of Beauty Award Winner✓ Medium Coverage✓ Gluten Free✓ Matte Finish✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Without Parabens
What it is: A universal must-have matte palette formulated to be easily buildable so that it can go from natural to dramatic without causing fallout.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is also paraben-free and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Inspired by human skin tones from light to deep, this custom, pro matte formula has a featherlight creamy feel and applies evenly with medium buildable and blendable coverage. The timeless palette offers superior grip and adherence with minimal fallout for the cleanest application.

This Set Contains:
- 12 x 0.03 oz/ 1g Eyeshadows
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Lighter shades can work well as an allover base, highlighter on the browbone, or in the inner corners of the eye.
-Contour and define the crease with the medium and deeper shades.
-Fill in or darken the brows with the shade of your choice.
-Mario's favorite brushes to use with this palette are EF 2, E 3, and E5 (each sold separately).
-Matte 12 contains carbon black pigment, which is five times more intense than a traditional black shadow. Use it to create a dramatic, blacker-than-black effect.
Ingredients+
Matte 1:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Silica, Alumina, Glycerin, Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492).

Matte 2, Matte 3:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Alumina, Glycerin, Silica. May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492), Ultramarines (Ci 77007), Carmine (Ci 75470).

Matte 4, Matte 6, Matte 11:
Talc, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Zinc Stearate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone Matte 5 Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Alumina, Glycerin, Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Ultramarines (Ci 77007), Carmine (Ci 75470).

Matte 7:
Talc, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Zinc Stearate, Zea Mays (Corn) Starch [Zea Mays Starch], Dimethicone, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499).

Matte 8:
Talc, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Zinc Stearate, Caprylic/Caprictriglyceride, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Dimethicone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499).

Matte 9:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Ultramarines (Ci 77007), Carmine (Ci 75470).

Matte 10:
Talc, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Zea Mays (Corn) Starch [Zea Mays Starch], Dimethicone, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Zinc Stearate, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Ultramarines (Ci 77007), Carmine (Ci 75470).

Matte 12:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Dimethicone, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil [Simmondsia Chinensis Oil], Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Iron Oxides, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Zea Mays (Corn) Starch [Zea Mays Starch]. May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Yellow 5 Lake (Ci 19140), Ultramarines (Ci 77007), Carmine (Ci 75470).
